note_tweet.text:
I was starting to think my Dot in Codex was useless.

I was using it to find Pumpfun wallets to research for copy trading. Sometimes it spent 12 hours going through addresses without giving me a result.

I’d seen similar complaints from other users, so I was getting pretty frustrated.

Then I gave it two instructions:

• Report completed work every 10 minutes  
• Look for a faster approach if one is available  

Results started coming in right after that.

I added both at once, so I can’t tell which made the difference.

Here’s the version I’d reuse:

“Every 10 minutes, report:
• What you’ve completed
• What’s blocking progress
• What you’ll do next

Look for a faster way to complete the task without dropping the requirements. Keep working between updates.”

If your agent has been working for hours with little to show, try it.
